fi-xiphophorus-helleri.title: Swordtail
fi-xiphophorus-helleri.summary: The green swordtail, Xiphophorus hellerii, is a livebearer native to southeastern Mexico, Guatemala, Belize and Honduras. Among the world's most recognisable aquarium fishes, it is ubiquitous in the…
rows: Omnivore. Stomach analyses of wild specimens have shown it to be a generalised omnivore, feeding on a range of aquatic and terrestrial invertebrates, organic detritus, algae, and other plant material.
Native to southeastern Mexico, central Guatemala, southern Belize, and northwestern Honduras.
notes: Choice of décor is not especially critical though it tends to look best in a heavily-planted set-up with a dark substrate.
Wild forms should also suit an aquarium arranged to resemble a flowing stream with water-worn rocks and small boulders.
